read_scope: pp74–97 monitor, endurance, access expressions, object types and lifecycle
pp106–117 security guidance, shielded connection, protected update and AUTO
sources.assessment: Read these sections, not a whole-manual approval. They support a conditional HMAC/AUTO/counter experiment, not physically qualified enforcement.
Build identity must be read from the actual part. Improved asymmetric SCA protection is not an independently established remedy for every attack.
Retrieved; exact reset retention, replay, resynchronization and full command/response protection still require targeted protocol review and H02S traces.
HMAC output is returned to MCU; default HMAC communication protection is command-only. Full response protection must be explicitly requested.
Headers are API evidence, not a substitute for device command semantics.
Example setup permissions are not production policies; no code was imported.

read_scope: AppendixB beginning, not complete proof audit
sources.assessment: Vendor scheme depends on MAC-and-Destroy internal-key confidentiality. Do not transpose the proof after the advisory invalidates its physical assumption.
MAC_And_Destroy 0x90 uses slot0..127, input32/output32. ECDSA/EdDSA are not native BIP340; handshake X25519 is not raw secp256k1 ECDH.

read_scope: section3 maintenance requirements and interruption warning
sources.assessment: Immutable Tropic boot root differs from vendor update public key. Custom vendor key requires a specially provisioned part and does not remove the ROM root.
Four write-once public X25519 pairing slots; invalidation is permanent. Default private key public; normal first use requires fresh private slot and default invalidation.

read_scope: sections1–3 I/R configuration and UAP semantics
sources.assessment: Effective config is bitwise I AND R; I bits only clear; R changes are reversible subject to policy; restart applies changes. UAP revocation is not revocation of vendor firmware authority.
Index and advisory/catalog naming differ; a guessed T310 part-page URL returned404. No equivalence of T301 and T310 is asserted.
